snippet.title: A Treasure hunter has returned! - WarioLand Moveset Trailer (WIP)
snippet.description:
Wario has returned to his roots with this new Moveset mod! He's bringing back his punches, rolls and muscles to fight in the grand battle that is Super Smash Brothers Ultimate!

You can stay up to date with the moveset here,
